config._note: Expense-reimbursement claim (onkostendeclaratie). A single Expense holds one claim (amount / currency / category / date + attached receipt) and a submit -> approve/reject -> reimburse lifecycle (x-openregister-lifecycle on `status`). Content starts at gridY 0 with the 'Claim' data (title/description/amount/currency/category/expenseDate/receiptFile) then 'Approval' (status/submittedAt/approvedBy/approvedAt/rejectionReason/reimbursedAt) below it, both excluding employeeId since Related already resolves the claiming Employee by name; an amount KPI stat sits top-right so the payout figure is unmissable, with Related beneath it matching the combined left-column height. The Files widget (receipt / bon) runs full-width AFTER the domain cards, same placement convention as Timesheet's approval evidence -- the approver reads the claim record first, then opens the receipt to verify it. NO email/calendar/talk -- Expense declares no comms linkedTypes; a reimbursement claim is a financial/HR record, not a correspondence thread. lifecycleActions expose submit/approve/reject/reimburse (approve/reject guarded server-side by NoSelfApprovalGuard; reimburse is terminal). Audit history is a sidebar tab. receipt-ocr (2026-07-16): page-level action "Extract receipt data" mirrors PayslipDetail's "Genereer PDF" shape -- POST /api/expenses/extract-receipt with {expenseId: @objectId}, guarded server-side by ExpenseController::authorizeExpense() (resolve-first RBAC) then an admin-or-owner ownership check. expenses-travel-calculation (2026-09-29): a 'Travel' data widget at gridY 6 shows the trip (travelType, distanceKm, transportMode, fuelType) and what humaniq calculated from it (ratePerKm, taxFreeAmount, taxableAmount, amountSource, read-only: TravelAmountListener stamps them on save). Approval moves to gridY 10, the receipt to gridY 14, and Related grows to 12 rows to match the left column. payroll-expenses-and-allowances (2026-09-30): Approval also shows reimbursementRoute (with the salary or directly; stamped at approval from the employer setting expense_reimbursement_route, changeable while the claim waits, refused for a claim with a taxable part or one a payroll run holds) and the read-only payrollRunId/paidInPeriod the run stamps. Reimburse stays for the direct route; a payroll-route claim is marked reimbursed when its run is approved and a manual reimburse is refused server-side (ExpenseRouteListener).

params.title: Commuting arrangements
params.description: Each employee's commute and the fixed monthly allowance humaniq calculates for it with the 214-day rule.

params.title: Commuting arrangement
params.note: expenses-travel-calculation (2026-09-29): one employee's commute. The data widget excludes employeeId (Related resolves it) and shows the calculated allowance read-only (TravelAmountListener stamps it on save). 'Calculate distance' posts {arrangementId: @objectId} to /api/travel/route-distance, which reads the arrangement under the caller's RBAC (404), lets only its employee before approval or HR/admin change it (403), and answers 409 when integriq or its route planner source is absent, keeping the typed distance. lifecycleActions mirror the schema: submit, approve/reject (NoSelfApprovalGuard), end.

headerActions.label: Calculate distance
headerActions.successMessage: Distance calculated by the route planner.
headerActions.errorMessage: No route planner is available, so the distance you typed is kept.

params.title: Recurring allowances
params.description: Fixed allowances paid every month with the salary, such as a home-working, travel or telephone allowance. A second HR adviser activates each one.

params.title: Recurring allowance
params.note: payroll-expenses-and-allowances (2026-09-30): one employee's standing allowance. The payroll run pays it in every period it covers while active: the taxed part into the gross, the untaxed part (capped at the home-working norm per day, or the commuting arrangement's tax-free part for travel) on top of net, and one WKR declaration per payment. RecurringAllowanceStampListener stamps proposedBy, userId and administrationId; activate is guarded by NoSelfApprovalGuard so neither the drafter nor the employee can activate it.

params.title: Mobility reports
params.description: The yearly business and commuting kilometres per transport mode and fuel, for the CO2 reporting duty of employers with 100 or more employees. Add a year, then compile it.

params.title: Mobility report
params.note: expenses-travel-calculation (2026-09-29): one administration's yearly WPM figures. 'Compile' posts {administrationId, year} from the object to /api/travel/wpm-report (HR of that administration or an administrator, 403 otherwise), which recomputes businessKm, commuteKm, the headcount against the threshold and tripsWithoutMode, and updates this record. Every figure is read-only: only compiling writes them.

headerActions.label: Compile
headerActions.errorMessage: The mobility report could not be compiled. Only HR of this administration or an administrator can compile it.
